whenToUse: Use designsetgo/section as the top-level block for every page section (hero, feature intro, CTA band, footer callout). It stacks its children vertically with consistent padding/gap, and it is the project's documented top-level building block — never wrap it, or nest several of it, inside a single outer container.
avoid: Do not wrap multiple sections inside one outer designsetgo/section or core/group so the page has only one top-level block — each section belongs at the top level of the tree on its own.
Do not use section for a horizontal row of items (buttons, cards) — use designsetgo/row instead; section's default layout is a vertical flex stack.
Do not use section for a responsive multi-column grid — use designsetgo/grid instead.
Do not put more than one level-1 heading (core/heading with level 1) across the page — one section should carry the page's H1, and later sections should start at H2 or lower.
Do not skip heading levels inside a section's content (e.g. an H2 straight to an H4) — step down one level at a time.
